text:
kevin: Quick alignment — who owns the per-customer dashboard and what runtime fields do you need to make per-org views reliable? thinking about routing policies, quotas, and noisy tenant detection. cc @sara @david

maya: Product wants a default per-org dashboard (cost, p95 latency, active connections) + a privacy toggle. Also need historical usage by model_version and route. We also want an obvious place to show quota windows and next billing estimate.

sara: Platform will own the console surface and role perms. From runtime we need these tags on every request: org_id, model, model_version, route, backend_pool. Also a trace_sampling flag. Example: `request.labels = {org_id: "o_1234", model: "gptx-1", model_version: "v2"}`

david: Runtime note: we can add org_id and model_version to logs/metrics. Two constraints: (1) do not emit customer_display_name by default (PII) — opt-in only in Private/VPC. (2) full token traces should be sampled (1-in-10) to control cost. Planned metric names: `redwood.request.count`, `redwood.request.latency_p95_ms`, `redwood.kvcache.hit_rate` — all with labels.

alex: Ops perspective: for noisy-tenant detection we need `concurrent_sessions{org_id}` gauge and `error_rate_by_org`. Alert rule suggestions: sustained RPS > 2x baseline OR token drop ratio > 30% over 5m. Also compute a rolling noisy_score (5m window, 1h trend) to drive watchlist.

maya: UX: per-org view should default to aggregated (no PII) with an opt-in drilldown for customers who allowed display_name. Include a canary/rollout row that shows traffic split and fallback model used if route fails.

sara: RBAC: we'll add roles `view-org` and `manage-org`. Console will filter org list based on these roles; backend ingest must enforce `org_id` scoping so APIs only return org-scoped metrics.

david: Implementation detail: adding `org_id` as a label to all Prometheus metrics is high-cardinality. Our proposal: emit per-org counters to a separate metrics-tenant pipeline (supports cardinality and retention), while keeping global aggregates without org label for global SLOs.

kevin: Action items: David - add org_id + sampling + endpoint name changes (INF-4432), Sara - prototype RBAC + console filters, Maya - mockups of per-org panel + billing view, Alex - propose noisy-tenant scoring formula. Sync Thur 10am? :calendar:

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline update: created ticket INF-4432 for runtime tagging work.

sara: I'll drop a short RFC in #eng-platform/docs with recommended metric schema and RBAC contract, and ping the list.

kevin: Example query for console to compute per-org saturation: `sum by (org_id) (rate(redwood.request.count[5m])) / sum by (org_id) (redwood.capacity.units_total)` — include `billing_unit` label to map to pricing.

maya: +1 to billing_unit label. thanks everyone, see you Thursday. :thumbsup:
